title: Bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <!-- rear wheel -->
    <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='18' stroke='#8FD3FF' stroke-width='4'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='12' stroke='#4FB8F0' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFE36E' stroke='none'/>
    <!-- spokes rear -->
    <g stroke='#B8E6FF' stroke-width='1.5'>
      <line x1='28' y1='50' x2='28' y2='86'/>
      <line x1='10' y1='68' x2='46' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='15' y1='55' x2='41' y2='81'/>
      <line x1='41' y1='55' x2='15' y2='81'/>
    </g>
    <!-- front wheel -->
    <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='18' stroke='#8FD3FF' stroke-width='4'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='12' stroke='#4FB8F0' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFE36E' stroke='none'/>
    <g stroke='#B8E6FF' stroke-width='1.5'>
      <line x1='74' y1='50' x2='74' y2='86'/>
      <line x1='56' y1='68' x2='92' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='61' y1='55' x2='87' y2='81'/>
      <line x1='87' y1='55' x2='61' y2='81'/>
    </g>
    <!-- frame -->
    <g stroke='#FF6E8A' stroke-width='5'>
      <line x1='28' y1='68' x2='50' y2='42'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='74' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='44' y2='70'/>
      <line x1='28' y1='68' x2='44' y2='70'/>
      <line x1='44' y1='70' x2='74' y2='68'/>
    </g>
    <!-- seat -->
    <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='46' y2='30' stroke='#C9A24B' stroke-width='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='45' cy='28' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#FFD66E'/>
    <!-- handlebar -->
    <line x1='74' y1='68' x2='82' y2='34' stroke='#C9A24B' stroke-width='3'/>
    <path d='M72 30 Q82 24 90 32' stroke='#FFD66E' stroke-width='4'/>
    <!-- pedal crank -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='70' r='4' fill='#B9F0C0' stroke='none'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='70' x2='52' y2='76' stroke='#7DE08E' stroke-width='3'/>
    <line x1='52' y1='76' x2='56' y2='73' stroke='#7DE08E' stroke-width='4'/>
  </g>
  <!-- front wheel rim highlight -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#D6F2FF' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#D6F2FF' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
